mapper.select: select p.id from sys_post p inner join sys_user_post up on up.post_id = p.id where up.user_id = #{userId} order by p.post_sort, p.id

select p.id, p.post_name, p.post_code, p.post_sort, p.status from sys_post p inner join sys_user_post up on up.post_id = p.id inner join sys_user u on u.id = up.user_id where u.user_name = #{userName} order by p.post_sort, p.id
